results.title: Brent crude jumps above $107 amid escalating Middle East tensions
results.description: Crude oil prices jumped sharply on Monday, with Brent crude rising above $107 a barrel, amid escalating tensions in the Middle East raising fears of disruptions to global energy supplies.
